answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a foundational kernel for Sybil resistance, requiring agents to solve unique verification challenges to join the network. By forcing attackers to acquire scarce biometric or social data, the cost of generating identities becomes a steep financial spiral. Just as a single grain of sand builds a dune, each verified agent adds to collective security, ensuring that adversaries cannot flood the system with cheap clones without incurring prohibitive capital expenditures.
